title: Verkehrsunfall und Festnahme nach Flucht vor Verkehrskontrolle – zwei Polizisten verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: After fleeing a traffic check at high speed, a 15-year-old driver crashed into a police car at the Uhlandstraße/Steinplatz junction and was arrested. He was suspected of being under the influence of drugs and had no valid driving licence.
